items.title: Jack Sheldon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Well I guess all the real good band leaders, like Duke Ellington, that’s the way he does it too

ctx.x: And Benny, he was good at doing that. Well I guess all the real good band leaders, like Duke Ellington, that’s the way he does it too, he uses everybody to their—
Yeah, he’d write to their sound and their personality.
